verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a programmatic way to pull usage or billing breakdowns, such as an invoice or charges endpoint, or a per-team or per-workload cost report. What it does show is related but different: generic claims that the REST API and CLI cover the entire platform, an agent skill that can "check balances", autobilling top-ups, per-second billing and a teams feature. None of these establishes the ability to attribute GPU spend by team or workload.
